$description: Case file export schema for auditor-ready evidence packets. A single ZIP containing everything needed to audit and reproduce verification offline.

manifest.description: SHA256 hashes for all files in the case file

evidenceIndex.description: Evidence record subset for the requested record + policy snapshot

verifyInstructions.description: Single-page operator/auditor instructions for offline verification

sloProof.description: SLO budget enforcement proof (if action was blocked)

resumeProof.description: Autonomy resume proof (if resumed from pause)

breakGlassProof.description: Break-glass activation proof (if break-glass was used)

ledgerSnapshot.description: Offline-capable HTML viewer for this record

missingOptional.description: Optional files that were not present

policySnapshot.description: Snapshot of active policies at time of record

invariants.deterministicOrdering: Files must be added in alphabetical order by path
invariants.failClosed: Missing required artifacts for tier cause hard failure with reason code
invariants.pathTraversalRejected: Record IDs containing path traversal sequences are rejected
invariants.hashVerifiable: ZIP hash is reproducible from same inputs

reasonCodes.RECORD_NOT_FOUND: Requested record ID not found in evidence index
reasonCodes.BUNDLE_MISSING: Required evidence bundle not found for tier
reasonCodes.CUSTODY_MISSING: Required custody attestation not found for tier
reasonCodes.VERIFY_FAILED: Bundle verification failed during case file generation
reasonCodes.PATH_TRAVERSAL: Record ID contains invalid path characters
reasonCodes.INDEX_INVALID: Evidence index is missing or malformed
